facts.value: The canonical source declares a file-local StageCallbacks grTZd_StageCallbacks[4] and an externally visible StageData grTZd_StageData, both with static storage duration. The callback array has three populated rows followed by a row of four null callbacks and zero flags. Each row contains on_init, callback1, gobj_proc, callback3 and a flags union. The descriptor initializes the stage identity, table/resource pointers, lifecycle and global hooks, and flags2 = 1; its omitted joints and joint_count fields default to NULL and zero. These declarations establish source types and initial values, not compiled section contents or adjacency.
